verdict.rationale: ZCode documents its own provider configuration mechanism: the ZCODE_BUILTIN_PROVIDER_CONFIG_FILE env var points to a local provider config file and otherwise falls back to a built-in config. It also advertises GLM-5.3-Flash model integration, so some model/provider selection exists, but the evidence never shows choosing among models from multiple providers or a per-session model picker. Missing for 10: documented multi-provider support (non-GLM providers), an in-session model selection UI or CLI flag, a list of supported models/providers, and independent hands-on corroboration of switching models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers
